scope: DNSPod International native driver against a verified local TLS HTTP protocol fixture; no external account requests.

sources.reviewed: Domain.Info identity and numeric domain ID.
Record.List offset/length, numeric record ID, literal TXT value, enabled flag; Record.Create and Record.Remove.
Global user_token authentication. This older document contains a generic dnsapi.cn reference; actual international action URLs and acme.sh establish api.dnspod.com.
International api.dnspod.com endpoint; DPI_Id/DPI_Key login_token authentication.

authentication: Default login_token; optional DPI_AuthField explicitly permits only login_token or user_token. Required DPI_Id is numeric; DPI_Key cannot contain a comma. Credential material is excluded from this summary.
ownership: Existing durable receipt framework binds owner, provider, credential hash, canonical challenge name/value, zone ID/name and record ID. Full bounded list and exact identity checks precede cleanup; only the owned record ID is removed. Borrowed existing records are retained; uncertain create responses are recovered by list without replaying creation.
covered_behaviors: Trusted TLS and rejection of untrusted TLS, authenticated redirects, oversized responses and credential-bearing diagnostics.
Creation, repeat Present, durable receipt, changed credentials/owner and restart cleanup.
Lost create response, delayed remote commit and recovery without duplicate create.
Preexisting borrowed TXT, changed zone ID, changed record ID and externally replaced value.
Actual multi-page Record.List, duplicate page rejection, disabled TXT preflight and unrelated A/TXT preservation.
Two concurrent challenge values coexist and are independently cleaned.
Default/explicit login_token and explicit user_token; unsupported authentication selectors are rejected before network access.

runs.evidence: Captured successful tool output; no separate normal-run log.

toolchain: /workspace/.tools/go-1.27.2/go/bin/go; GOTOOLCHAIN=local; existing module and build caches; no dependency changes.

unimplemented_providers.blocker: Upstream upd.php mutates a shared host TXT slot with txtm=1 and clears it with txtm=2. No structured authoritative list, per-record ID or conditional exact-value deletion was established; unsafe whole-slot clearing is not implemented.

Upstream acme/dns.json GET checks status for a name/content existence query; a complete documented list/identity schema and uncertain-create recovery semantics were not established. A speculative response schema was not implemented.
Upstream depends on website login cookies and HTML forms. Stable zone/record identity, bounded complete listing and precise restart-safe deletion semantics were not independently established.

Upstream requires session/TOTP and domain environment switching; list-async embeds HTML hash/identifier attributes. Existing upstream removal matches TXT type/name and deletes all matching TXT values. This unsafe behavior is not a valid exact-ownership port and was not implemented.

limitations: No real vendor account, external DNS propagation or real CA issuance is claimed.
Local protocol conformance does not prove current vendor service behavior.
Four unsupported providers continue to fail explicitly.
No full suite, application build, VM, commit or push was run for this scoped change.
